name: bouncer
description: Bouncer mode for the Claude desktop app: one Bouncer session routes tickets to Bartender sessions, one ticket each, in their own worktrees.

status_codes.title: Status codes
status_codes.description: Short codes for ticket statuses in Bartender titles, as Name=Code pairs with ; between them. Use the status names of your tracker.
status_codes.default: Backlog=Bklog; Todo=Todo; In Progress=Dev; In Review=CR; In QA=QA; Done=Done; Canceled=Cxl; Duplicate=Dup; Open=Open; Closed=Done

records_dir.title: Ticket records folder
records_dir.description: The folder of the ticket records (one <TICKET>.md each), whose LEDGER sections hold the work to revisit, for example ~/.tickets. Blank: tickets/ in the plugin data folder.

linear_workspace_url.title: Linear workspace URL
linear_workspace_url.description: The Linear workspace that ticket keys in the band link to, as https://linear.app/<workspace>. A key opens <URL>/issue/<KEY>. Blank: keys are plain text.

bartender_skill.title: Bartender skill
bartender_skill.description: A skill with your own routing and gates, for example post-merge checks and approvals. The Bouncer loads it, and each Ticket Bartender brief starts with a line to load it. Blank: no skill.

ticket_effort.title: Ticket effort
ticket_effort.description: The effort of a Code or Spike Ticket Bartender: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.
